title: Humans Hallucinate Too: Language Models Identify and Correct Subjective Annotation Errors With Label-in-a-Haystack Prompts
reasoning: The paper includes evaluations using the Moral Foundations Reddit Corpus (MFRC) and the QueerReclaimLex dataset. It specifically aims to improve modeling for complex subjective tasks like moral foundation prediction and identifies ethical biases in how LLMs handle harm labels and reclaimed slurs.
